title: AMD MCP per-action policy
description: Validates per-action policy files at knowledge/integrations/amd/<domain>/<action>.policy.data.json. Bumped to v1.1 on 2026-06-04 per AMD_TOOLS_FULL_BUILDOUT_PLAN-final.txt MERGED-E0.1: added 4 new domains (ehr, masterfiles, system, meta); top-level `beta` flag (DUO-8); top-level `requires_streaming` flag (DUO-13); conditional-nullable tool_name when domain=='meta' (DUO-1, RISK-2). v1 schema IDs remain accepted via oneOf so legacy policy files (and the 4 existing factory.py policy_id strings) continue to validate.

action.description: Raw AMD action string. Must match the action in the generated schema.

tool_name.description: MCP tool name; convention is amd_<domain>_<action>. May be null ONLY when domain=='meta' (helper actions suppressed from list_tools per DUO-1).

beta.description: Top-level beta marker per DUO-8. When true, the action is flagged in audit logs and the per-server CLAUDE.md notes the beta status.

requires_streaming.description: Top-level streaming flag per DUO-13. When true, the action's transport requires streaming (e.g. uploadfile). Handlers must check this and may enforce additional caps.
